$comment: Licence and attribution metadata copied verbatim into the shipped asset manifest. Every dataset Monosai redistributes must appear here.

attribution.role: Morphological analyser runtime and its bundled Japanese dictionary

licences.holder: Nara Institute of Science and Technology (NAIST)

attribution.name: JMdict (English, common words only)
attribution.role: Offline Japanese-English dictionary for word lookup

licences.holder: Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG)

attribution.noticeEn: Dictionary data is derived from JMdict, Copyright Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, used under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International licence, via the jmdict-simplified JSON conversion. Monosai's compacted subset is redistributed under the same licence.
attribution.redistribution: Permitted under CC BY-SA 4.0; the derived asset carries the same licence.

attribution.name: Monosai grammar presets
attribution.role: Ordered difficulty presets whose prose guidance steers generation prompts and advisory grammar review
attribution.noticeEn: The grammar difficulty presets are written for Monosai and dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. The Japan Foundation and JEES do not publish an official exhaustive JLPT grammar list; a preset caption records only where its patterns are conventionally taught.

attribution.name: Monosai structural baseline
attribution.role: Sentence-building forms treated as readable without an Anki entry
attribution.noticeEn: The structural baseline is written for Monosai and dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
